mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_change_token (user_id, new_email, token_hash, expires_at, requested_ip, credential_generation) VALUES (#{userId}, #{newEmail}, #{tokenHash}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{expiryMinutes} MINUTE), #{requestedIp}, #{credentialGeneration})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM email_change_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() AND credential_generation = (SELECT session_epoch FROM app_user WHERE id = email_change_token.user_id) )

SELECT id, user_id, credential_generation, new_email, token_hash, expires_at, exchanged_at, consumed_at, requested_ip, created_at FROM email_change_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.update: UPDATE email_change_token SET exchanged_at = COALESCE(exchanged_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP()), exchange_owner_hash = COALESCE(exchange_owner_hash, #{exchangeOwnerHash}) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND (exchanged_at IS NULL OR exchange_owner_hash = #{exchangeOwnerHash}) AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM email_change_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchange_owner_hash = #{exchangeOwnerHash} AND exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() FOR SHARE

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM email_change_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() AND credential_generation = (SELECT session_epoch FROM app_user WHERE id = email_change_token.user_id) )

SELECT id, user_id, credential_generation, new_email, token_hash, expires_at, exchanged_at, consumed_at, requested_ip, created_at FROM email_change_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.update: UPDATE email_change_token SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
UPDATE email_change_token SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM email_change_token WHERE expires_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP() OR consumed_at IS NOT NULL
